response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, cnt, 100.0 * cnt / SUM(cnt) OVER () AS share FROM counts), avg_calc AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_calc)) AS avg_excess FROM shares WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_calc)
